verdict.rationale: The Settings docs describe a Telemetry toggle that lets users enable or disable sharing interaction logs to improve models. That is a direct, user-controlled opt-out from model-training data use. The evidence is a single short line, though, so the scope and guarantees of the opt-out are not shown. Missing for 10: detail on what data the toggle covers (prompts, code, attachments), whether it is off by default or tied to account or plan tier, retention and data-use policy terms, and independent or hands-on confirmation that disabling it prevents training use.
